title: Integrated communication: Public discourse — the debate coach

frames.title: Lesson 120 · Integrated communication: Public discourse — the debate coach

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre preparação para debates a partir de uma entrevista, formulando réplicas com ênfase e ritmo adequados.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.intro: A university debate coach describes how teams are trained.
qa: Interviewer: What separates a good debater from a great one?
The great ones **listen**. A good debater **recites**; a great one **rebuts**. They find the **hinge** of the opponent’s case and **press on it**.
Interviewer: How do you teach rebuttal?
We drill a **four-step** reply: **state** the claim, **label** the flaw, **explain** why it matters, **replace** it with a better point. **Concede** a minor argument if it **buys credibility**.
**Speed**. Students think faster means stronger. In fact **clarity** wins rounds. **Slow down**, **signpost**, and **land** one idea at a time.

items.q: A great debater mostly recites prepared text.
items.why: A good debater recites; a great one rebuts.

items.q: The coach teaches a four-step reply.
Speed wins rounds, according to the coach.

blocks.body: Rebater = **resumir com justiça**, **apontar o defeito**, **mostrar a consequência** e **oferecer algo melhor**. *Signposting* (*First, … Second, …*) guia o ouvinte.
Atacar a pessoa (*ad hominem*) enfraquece a réplica; ataque o **argumento**.

items.s: A great debater ___ , a good one recites. (rebut)
This argument ___ the cost of delay. (overlook)
___ fact, the evidence shows the opposite. (in)

blocks.title: Practice room
lines: State their claim, label the flaw, explain the impact.
Enuncie a tese deles, aponte a falha, explique o impacto.
They claim costs will fall, but that overlooks maintenance.
Eles dizem que os custos cairão, mas isso ignora a manutenção.
In fact, the evidence shows costs doubling.
Na verdade, as evidências mostram custos dobrando.

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances

items.label: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances
items.note: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances: o acento muda o sentido (He said she STOLE it × he said SHE stole it) e as pausas separam ideias técnicas densas.
words: I didn’t SAY he did it.
I didn’t say HE did it.
I didn’t say he DID it.

prompts.model: My opponent claims that costs will fall.
That overlooks the cost of maintenance.
In fact, the evidence shows the opposite.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence rebuttal to a fictional claim that homework should be abolished, using the four steps.
blocks.model: My opponent claims that homework should be abolished. That overlooks the value of independent practice. This matters because skills fade without repetition. In fact, studies of study habits suggest short, focused homework helps. Much as I accept the stress, abolition is too blunt. A better remedy is less, and better, homework.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
